title: Component assembly, derivation, and open-input status of the $\alpha_{EM}$ fixed point
html:
Proved results and assumptions

The fine-structure constant emerges as the symbolic root of a self-consistent fixed-point equation. This path is additive and self-consistent. The formulation avoids the refuted multiplicative Chern–Simons or gluon-octet forms.

The equation integrates three components. Only the third remains open:

  1. Tree term q\cdot[9]_q\cdot[10]_q: The bare inverse coupling from Electromagnetic coupling from the antisymmetric braiding and force-carrier crossings.
  2. Zero-mode shift 2/(3\pi) = 2g/(4\pi(g-1))\big|_{g=4}: The photon infrared harmonic-1-form contribution on Bring's surface. This is proved in Photon IR zero-mode on Bring's surface. The normalization 8\pi = \pi b_1 = \pi\dim H^1(M_{\text{Bring}}) maintains the harmonic count.
  3. \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) normalization H\cdot(1-h^2\alpha): The Habiro deformation (1-h^2\alpha) with coefficient H = [2]_q/(8\pi). Identifying the exact \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) correction to H with a class in B_3(\mathbb{C}) is the single open input. It enters as an explicit hypothesis.

Genuine derivation, not projection

The hypothesis carries only the B_3(\mathbb{C}) normalization, and the conclusion is derived from it. For \alpha \neq 0 the fixed-point equation is equivalent to the cubic root condition. The main result composes this equivalence with the normalization hypothesis. The proof is a genuine derivation.

Numerical context

At q_0, the tree term and zero-mode reproduce 1/\alpha to -4.2\times 10^{-6} (additive Bring zero-mode form of 1/\alpha_{EM}). The \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) self-consistency term supplies the residual \mathcal{O}(\alpha) correction. The conjectural B_3(\mathbb{C}) Bloch-class content supplies its exact form. The cubic P features a real root near 1/137.036. CODATA-consistency provides the empirical foundation of the conjecture.

Status

The sole open element remains the B_3(\mathbb{C}) \mathcal{O}(\alpha^2) normalization. The tree/zero-mode assembly of T, the algebraic equivalence of the fixed point, and the derivation of P(\alpha)=0 are proved. The normalization hypothesis remains unestablished, and the primary conjecture is not closed.
